South Carolina.focus: Connections to Care, Leveling Up, Wellness Within Reach, sustainability and a tech fund
South Carolina.description: South Carolina plans five integrated initiatives for its roughly 1.75 million rural residents (32.6% of the state), focused on chronic disease and maternal health.
initiatives: Connections to Care
EHRs, remote patient monitoring, telehealth and a statewide resource database.
Leveling Up
Scaling successful pilots in chronic disease, pediatric care quality and workforce.
Wellness Within Reach
Mobile health units, crisis response teams and pop-up clinics.
Shoring Up to Sustainability and Tech Catalyst Fund
Workforce, facility upgrades and training, plus support for rural health technology startups.

South Dakota.focus: Technology and data, workforce, access close to home, care delivery
South Dakota.description: South Dakota's Department of Health plans four interconnected goals to build lasting capacity in one of America's most rural states.
initiatives: Connecting Technology & Data
Certified EHRs, HIE integration, telehealth, cybersecurity and a Rural Data Atlas.
Advancing the Rural Workforce
Recruitment and retention incentives and expanded CHW training and certification.
Access close to home
Innovative payment models, facility reinvention, chronic disease and maternal health services.
Transforming care delivery
Behavioral health integrated into primary care and stronger EMS.

Tennessee.focus: Better Care, Closer to Home: five goals
Tennessee.description: Tennessee's plan, under the principle 'Better Care, Closer to Home,' builds on the Governor's Rural Health Taskforce and its Healthcare Resiliency Program.
initiatives: Rural Healthcare Transformation
Right-sizing rural facilities and outcomes-based payment models.
Maternal and Child Health
Investments for strong starts for rural families.
Make Rural Tennessee Healthy Again
Prevention, early detection and nutrition security.
Technology and Workforce
Health-tech for efficiency and a workforce pipeline for local talent.

Texas.description: Texas HHSC's Rural Texas Strong plan sets out six initiatives for technology-supported rural wellness, powered by a revitalized workforce.
initiatives: Make Rural Texans Healthy Again
Nutrition, wellness and prevention.
Rural Texas Patients in the Driver's Seat
Consumer-facing technology connected to provider systems.
Lone Star Advanced AI and Telehealth
Telehealth and AI to connect rural patients with care.
The Next Generation of the Small Town Doctor and Team
Rural health workforce pipelines.

Utah.focus: Seven integrated initiatives across four pillars
Utah.description: Utah, 77% rural by area, plans seven integrated initiatives under four pillars: Making Rural Utahns Healthy, Workforce Development, Innovation and Access, and Technology Innovation.
initiatives: PATH
Lifelong wellness through nutrition, physical activity and healthy environments.
RISE
Rural workforce through career pathways, training and provider incentives.
SHIFT and FAST
Sustaining health infrastructure and financial approaches for sustainable transformation.
LIFT, SUPPORT and LINCS
Telehealth, shared operational resources and interoperability networks.
